blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) have made strong progress in multimodal understanding, yet most treat audio as monaural semantic content, limiting their ability to reason about where sounds originate and how they relate to the visual scene. Recent spatial audio-visual studies address parts of this problem, but often focus on specific abilities, such as spatial correspondence or direction and distance reasoning. In this work, we introduce HLR-AVSceneQA, a comprehensive benchmark with a hear-localize-reason hierarchy that evaluates whether models can recognize what is heard, localize sound sources in egocentric and allocentric views, and use these localized sources to reason about how they relate to the visual scene. We further introduce HLR-LLM, which augments a strong audio-visual foundation model with a binaural spatial audio branch alongside its monaural semantic audio pathway. We train HLR-LLM with a curriculum that incorporates final-stage chain-of-thought supervision for multi-step spatial reasoning. Experiments show that existing AV-LLMs remain limited in spatial grounding and relational reasoning, while HLR-LLM substantially improves spatial audio-visual scene understanding without compromising semantic audio-visual perception.
blocks.zh: 视听大型语言模型(AV-LLMs)在多模式理解上取得了显著进展,然而大多数将音频视为一元语义内容,限制了他们解释声音发源地和与视觉场景的关系的能力. 近期的空间视听研究针对了这个问题的部分内容,但往往侧重于特定的能力,如空间通信或方向和距离推理等. 在这部作品中,我们引入了HLR-AVSceneQA,这是一个具有听觉本地化-理性分级的综合基准,它评价模型是否能够识别所听到的,将声音源本地化为以自负为中心,以异心为中心的观点,并利用这些本地化的源来解释它们与视觉场景的关系. 我们进一步引入了HLR-LLM,它增加了一个强大的视听基础模型,其二元空间音频分支与其元语义音频路径相并列. 我们用一个课程来培训HLR-LLM,该课程包含对多步骤空间推理的最后阶段思维链监督。 实验表明,现有的AV-LLM在空间地平面和关系推理方面仍然有限,而HLR-LLM在不损害语义视听感知的情况下大幅度地改进了空间视听场景理解.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Spatial audio and vision provide complementary cues for understanding a scene.
We may hear someone calling from another room, infer that a ringing alarm clock is hidden below the bed by combining its direction with the visible layout, or decide where to move to get closer to a sound by relating auditory distance cues to nearby objects.
Such everyday situations show that audio-visual scene understanding requires more than recognizing a sound event or matching it to a visible object.
Accordingly, a spatially aware agent must infer where the sound originates, whether it is visible, why it may be hidden, and how its relation to the scene changes as the agent moves.
blocks.zh:
空间音频和视觉为理解一个场景提供了互补的提示.
我们可能听到有人从另一个房间打来电话,推断一个响起的闹钟被隐藏在床下,将它的方向和可见的布局结合起来,或者决定向何处移动,通过将听觉距离提示与相邻物体联系起来来接近声音.
这种日常情况表明,视听场景理解需要的不仅仅是识别出声音事件或将其与可见物体相匹配.
因此,空间意识的代理人必须推断出声音的发源地,是否可见,为何可能被隐藏,以及它与场景的关系随着代理人的移动而变化.

blocks.en: Recently, audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) Yao et al. (2024) ; Cheng et al. (2024) ; Tang et al. (2025) ; Xu et al. (2025a) ; Xu et al. (2025b) have shown strong progress in diverse multimodal understanding tasks, such as audio-visual question answering Ye et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2022) , temporal grounding Chowdhury et al. (2024) , and multimodal reasoning. However, most existing AV-LLMs treat audio primarily as monaural semantic content, focusing on what is heard rather than where it is heard. As a result, they struggle to reason about auditory sources in the physical scene, especially when a source is outside the camera view, occluded by objects, located in another room, or spatially ambiguous among multiple candidates. Spatial audio, such as binaural or multi-channel recordings, offers the direction and distance cues needed to overcome this limitation and support spatially grounded scene understanding.

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduce HLR-AVSceneQA , a comprehensive benchmark for spatial audio-visual scene understanding. As shown in Fig. Hear, Localize, and Reason: Spatially Aware Scene Understanding for Audio-Visual LLMs , HLR-AVSceneQA follows a hear-localize-reason hierarchy: spatial hearing evaluates what is heard, spatial grounding evaluates source localization in egocentric and allocentric views, and spatial relational reasoning evaluates how localized sound sources relate to the visual scene.
By treating localized sound-source information not only as a prediction target but also as spatial evidence for downstream reasoning, HLR-AVSceneQA enables systematic evaluation of spatial grounding and scene-level reasoning.
Unlike panoramic-input settings Ryu et al. (2026) , HLR-AVSceneQA uses normal-field-of-view observations, requiring models to reason about visible, occluded, and off-screen sources from partial visual evidence. We construct the benchmark with a simulator-based pipeline Chen et al. (2022) , producing diverse, controllable spatial audio-visual scenes with reliable annotations.

HLR-AVSceneQA不仅将本地化的音源信息作为预测目标,而且还作为下游推理的空间证据,从而能够系统评价空间地平面和场景级推理.

blocks.en:
We further introduce HLR-LLM , a spatially aware AV-LLM that extends audio-visual semantic understanding with explicit spatial audio modeling.
Built on an existing AV-LLM Xu et al. (2025a) and augmented with a spatial audio branch, HLR-LLM
improves spatial grounding and reasoning while preserving strong semantic perception.

blocks.en:
Experiments show that existing AV-LLMs, including commercial models that rely on monaural audio, struggle with spatial grounding and reasoning in our benchmark.
In contrast, HLR-LLM preserves strong semantic hearing ability, including sound event and speech recognition, while substantially improving spatial grounding and relational reasoning.
Transfer experiments on real-world spatial audio-visual recordings Shimada et al. (2023) further suggest that pretraining on HLR-AVSceneQA provides useful spatial priors for adaptation to real-world data.
Our contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh:
实验表明,现有的AV-LLMs,包括依赖一元音效的商业模型,在我们的基准中与空间地平面和推理相搏.
相形之下,HLR-LLM保留了强大的语义听力能力,包括声音事件和语音识别,同时大大地改善了空间地平面和关系推理.
关于真实世界空间视听录音的转移实验Shimada等人(2023年)进一步表明,关于HLR-AVSceneQA的预训为适应真实世界数据提供了有用的空间前科.
我们的贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce HLR-AVSceneQA, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates spatial hearing and grounding both directly and as intermediate evidence for downstream spatial relational reasoning. • We propose HLR-LLM, a spatially aware AV-LLM that augments a strong foundation model with a spatial audio pathway to improve grounding and reasoning while preserving semantic perception. • We demonstrate that final-stage chain-of-thought curriculum training improves multi-step spatial reasoning by connecting auditory, spatial, and visual cues through intermediate reasoning steps.

blocks.en:
Spatial audio provides geometric cues about sound sources beyond monaural semantic content. While monaural audio understanding mainly targets semantic tasks, such as automatic speech recognition Baevski et al. (2020) ; Radford et al. (2023) , sound event recognition Gemmeke et al. (2017) ; Kong et al. (2020) ; Gong et al. (2021) , and audio captioning Drossos et al. (2020) ; Kim et al. (2019) ; Kim et al. (2023) , spatial audio formats, such as binaural audio and first-order ambisonics (FOA), capture direction- and distance-related cues.
Early work on spatial audio explores sound event localization and detection (SELD), where models jointly identify active sound events and estimate the direction of arrival Adavanne et al. (2019) ; Shimada et al. (2021) ; Shimada et al. (2022) . More recent work connects spatial audio with language models for sound localization and reasoning Zheng et al. (2024) ; Biswas et al. (2026) ; Hyun-Bin et al. (2026) , learns spatially aware audio-text representations through contrastive objectives Devnani et al. (2024) ; Seki et al. (2026) , and adapts FOA inputs for far-field speech understanding Tang et al. (2024) ; Xie et al. (2025) . These works highlight the value of spatial hearing, but remain largely audio-only or speech-centric, leaving open how spatial auditory cues should be grounded in and reasoned over a visual scene.

blocks.en: General audio-visual benchmarks Sung-Bin et al. (2025) ; Chowdhury et al. (2025) ; Gong et al. (2026) ; Yang et al. (2022) ; Zhou et al. (2025) evaluate broad multimodal abilities, but do not focus on spatial sound-source understanding. Recent benchmarks have begun to address specific spatial capabilities: SAVVY-Bench Chen et al. (2025) evaluates dynamic egocentric/allocentric direction and distance reasoning, SpatialSceneQA Liu et al. (2026) focuses on RGB-D and FOA-based 3D grounding, and Hear You Are Ryu et al. (2026) studies sound-object correspondence with panoramic images. As summarized in Table 1 , these benchmarks cover complementary aspects of spatial audio-visual understanding, but focus on different subsets of capabilities. HLR-AVSceneQA instead provides a unified hear-localize-reason evaluation that spans spatial hearing, grounding, multi-source scenes, and scene-level relational reasoning, including whether localized sound-source information can support broader reasoning about the surrounding scene. It further uses normal-field-of-view egocentric observations, requiring models to reason about visible, off-screen, and hidden sound sources from partial visual observations.

blocks.en: We introduce HLR-AVSceneQA, a comprehensive benchmark for spatial audio-visual scene understanding. HLR-AVSceneQA follows a hear-localize-reason hierarchy that evaluates three capabilities: spatial hearing for recognizing what is heard, spatial grounding for localizing sound sources from egocentric and allocentric viewpoints, and spatial relational reasoning for understanding how localized sources relate to visible, hidden, nearby, or off-screen objects in the scene (Fig. Hear, Localize, and Reason: Spatially Aware Scene Understanding for Audio-Visual LLMs ). This hierarchy spans 12 tasks, as summarized in Table 2 . HLR-AVSceneQA contains 175,061 training and 21,808 test QA pairs, including 53,279 training and 4,869 test pairs from scenes with multiple simultaneously active sound sources. We also provide 94,519 CoT-augmented training pairs for multi-step spatial reasoning. Because collecting real-world spatial audio-visual data with accurate annotations is challenging, we construct the benchmark with a two-stage simulator-based pipeline: Stage I synthesizes spatial audio-visual scenes with structured metadata, and Stage II generates QA pairs from this metadata.
blocks.zh: 我们采用HLR-AVSceneQA,这是空间视听场景理解的全面基准. HLR- AV 场景 QA遵循一种听觉本地化-合理结构,评价三种能力:识别听觉的空间听觉,从自负和同心同德的角度将声音源定位的空间地基,以及了解本地化源与现场可见、隐蔽、相邻或外屏物体的关系的空间关系推理(图:听觉、本地化和原因:空间感知场景理解用于视听LLMs)。 如表2所概述,这种等级划分涉及12个任务。 HLR- AV 场景 QA包含175,061个训练以及21,808个测试QA对,包括53,279个训练以及4,869个来自场景的测试对,同时具有多个活性声音源. 我们还提供了94,519对共通性辅助训练对,用于多步空间推理. 由于收集真实世界的有准确说明的空间视听数据具有挑战性,我们用两阶段模拟器的管道构建基准: 第一阶段用结构化元数据合成了空间视听场景,第二阶段从这个元数据中生成了QA对.

blocks.en: 3.1 Stage I: Spatial audio-visual scene synthesis
blocks.zh: 3.1 第一阶段:空间视听场景综合

blocks.en:
We synthesize each sample in an indoor 3D scene from an agent’s egocentric viewpoint, where the agent pose defines both the RGB camera and the acoustic receiver.
We populate the scene with diverse candidate objects and designate up to two objects as active sound sources. Each sample includes a synchronized RGB observation, binaural audio, object layouts, source assignments, and geometric metadata for QA generation. Examples of rendered scenes and metadata are shown in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh:
我们在室内的三维场景中从一个代理的自我中心角度合成每个样本,其中代理的姿势既定义了RGB相机,也定义了相声接收器.
我们用不同的候选对象填充场景,并指定最多两个物体为活性声音源。 每个样本包括同步RGB观测,双音,对象布局,源任务,以及QA生成的几何元数据. 图2显示了制作场景和元数据的例子。

blocks.en: We use SoundSpaces 2.0 Chen et al. (2022) , which renders geometry-aware room acoustics and spatializes dry monaural clips into binaural audio. For 3D environments, we use HM3DSem Yadav et al. (2023) , which provides 216 indoor spaces and 3,100 rooms with dense object- and room-level semantics. These semantics support realistic rendering, layout-aware QA generation, and filtering of physically implausible placements. We use 145 scenes for training and 36 for testing.
blocks.zh: 我们使用声音空间2.0 陈等 (2022年),使几何感知室相声并空间化干寺道相片入双音. 对于3D环境,我们使用HM3DSem Yadav等人(2023年),它提供了216个室内空间和3100个房间,并配有密集的物体和室位语义. 这些语义支持现实的渲染,布局-意识的QA生成,以及物理上不可信的放置的过滤. 我们使用145场景进行培训,36场用于测试.

blocks.en:
We use non-speech sounds from VGGSound Chen et al. (2020) , which contains over 200,000 in-the-wild clips across 310+ classes.
Since some classes, such as sea waves or people cheering , are not naturally grounded to a single indoor object, we manually exclude them.
We further use ImageBind-based text-audio similarity to filter out likely mislabeled clips Girdhar et al. (2023) . For speech audio, we use LibriSpeech Panayotov et al. (2015) , which provides clean utterance-level transcripts for far-field speech recognition. We follow the official train/test splits of both VGGSound and LibriSpeech.
blocks.zh:
我们使用来自VGGSound Chen等人(2020年)的非口音,其中包含超过20万个遍及310个班级的无声片段.
由于有些课程,如海浪或人们欢呼, 并不是自然而然地基于一个室内物体,
我们进一步使用基于ImageBind的文本音频相似性来过滤Girdhar等人(2023年)可能贴错标签的剪辑。 对于语音音频,我们使用LibriSpeech Panayotov等人(2015年),为远地语音识别提供干净的语音层面记录. 我们跟随VGGSoud和LibriSpeech的官方列车/测试分出.

blocks.en:
We build a 3D mesh pool of sounding objects to insert into scenes. We collect available meshes from Objaverse-XL Deitke et al. (2023) , and supplement categories with insufficient coverage using off-the-shelf 2D/3D generation models Rombach et al. (2022) ; Xiang et al. (2025) .
All assets are manually checked to remove low-quality meshes. We keep approximately 81 meshes per category for training and 35 for testing.
blocks.zh:
我们造出一个3D网格的探测器 插入到场景中 我们从Objaverse-XL Deitke 等人(2023年)收集可用的元数据,并使用现成的2D/3D生成模型Rombach等人(2022年);Xiang等人(2025年)补充覆盖面不足的类别。
对所有资产进行人工检查,以去除低质量的胶片。 我们保留大约每类81个网点用于培训,35个用于测试。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Examples of rendered scenes and metadata. Our dataset covers diverse scenarios that require spatially aware audio-visual reasoning, including (a) sound sources occluded by objects and (b) ambiguous sound sources among same-category instances. Each sample is summarized with structured scene metadata. Yellow denotes existing scene objects, pink denotes inserted objects, blue denotes sounding objects, and green denotes the agent.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 制作场景和元数据的例子。 我们的数据集涵盖各种情况,需要空间意识的视听推理,包括(a) 物体所占用的音源;(b) 同一类情况下声音源模糊不清。 每个样本都以结构化场景元数据进行总结. 黄色表示已存在的场景对象,粉红色表示被插入对象,蓝色表示发声对象,绿色表示代理.

blocks.en: Given a room from HM3DSem, we insert 2 to 6 candidate object meshes based on available free space and room scale. We activate up to two sound sources and attach them to selected objects. Some audio-object pairs are semantically matched, while others are intentionally spatially aligned but semantically mismatched . We further include sources that are fully visible, occluded by an object, placed in an adjacent room, or outside the agent’s field of view, introducing realistic ambiguity and preventing reliance on category matching alone. The final RGB image is rendered from the agent viewpoint with a 90 ∘ horizontal field of view at 1280 × \times 720 resolution, paired with binaural audio. For each sample, we export structured metadata, including agent pose, object identities and 3D coordinates, source-object assignments, visibility state, occlusion type, and pairwise geometry, to generate QA pairs with accurate labels.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个来自HM3DSem的房间,我们根据可用的免费空间和房间尺度,插入2至6个候选对象。 我们激活最多两个声音源,并将其附在选定的对象上。 一些音频-对象对是相配的,而另一些则有意在空间上对齐,但相配不匹配。 我们进一步包括完全可见、被物体所占据、放置在相邻房间或代理人视线之外的来源,从而造成现实的模糊性并避免仅依赖类别匹配。 最终的RGB图像从代理角度渲染出,以1280×\times 720分辨率的90QQ水平视野,与双音对接. 对于每个样本,我们导出结构化的元数据,包括代理站姿势,对象身份和3D坐标,源对象任务,能见度状态,被忽略类型,和对等几何,以生成带有准确标签的QA对.

blocks.en: 3.2 Stage II: Benchmark task design and QA construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 第二阶段:基准任务设计和质量保证施工

blocks.en: Given each rendered scene and its metadata, we generate QA pairs for three task families. To improve linguistic diversity while keeping evaluation stable, we vary question templates but preserve controlled answer formats. Most tasks use constrained outputs, such as multiple choice or discretized bins, while speech transcription and scene captioning are open-ended. Representative examples are shown in Table 2 , and additional construction and quality-control details are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 考虑到每个场景及其元数据,我们为三个任务组生成QA对. 为了提高语言多样性,同时保持评价的稳定,我们修改了问题模板,但保留了可控答案格式。 大多数任务使用受限输出,如多选择或盘式取出相机,而语音转录和场景字幕则无限制. 代表性例子见表2,附录C提供了其他建筑和质量控制细节。

blocks.en: This family evaluates semantic perception from spatial audio through sound event recognition and far-field speech recognition , which identify audible event categories and transcribe spoken content as the foundation for grounding and reasoning.
blocks.zh: 这个家族通过声音事件识别和远地语音识别来评价从空间音频的语义感知,这些语义感知将可听出的事件类别并转录口语内容作为地基和推理的基础.

blocks.en: This family evaluates sound-source localization in egocentric and allocentric frames, each with direction and distance estimation. Egocentric grounding localizes the source relative to the agent’s current viewpoint, while allocentric grounding localizes it from a transformed viewpoint, defined by standing at a reference object and facing another object. This tests both source localization and viewpoint-aware spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh: 这个家族在自负心和同心方框架中评价了声音源本地化,每个框架都有方向和距离估计. 以Egocent来定位源相对于代理当前视角,而以Apocent来定位则从一个被改变的视角来定义,即站在一个参考对象并面对另一个对象。 这既检验了源的本地化,也检验了视野的空间推理.

blocks.en:
This family extends source localization to scene-level reasoning by evaluating how localized sound sources relate to the visual scene. Visibility asks whether the source is
visible from the current view,
and correspondence asks which visible object is spatially aligned with the sound, where the answer may be semantically mismatched or None . Hidden-source localization identifies whether a non-visible source is hidden behind an object, in an adjacent room, or outside the field of view. Loudness change asks whether the source becomes louder or quieter after the agent moves to a target object; proximity reasoning asks which candidate object is nearest to the source; and scene captioning summarizes sound events, directions, and visibility states, including multiple emitters when present.
blocks.zh:
这个家族通过评价本地化的音源与视觉场景的关系,将源地化扩展到场景层面的推理. 可见度 问来源是否
从当前视图可见,
和函文询问哪个可见物体在空间上与声音对齐,其中的答案可能是错位或无。 隐藏源本地化可以识别非可见源是否隐藏在物体后方,相邻房间内,或视野外. 发声变化询问,在代理移动到目标对象后,源头是否变得更响亮或更安静;相近推理询问哪个候选对象最接近源头;而场景字幕则总结出声音事件,方向,和能见度状态,包括出现时的多发信号.

blocks.en:
We further provide chain-of-thought (CoT) answer variants for allocentric grounding and spatial relational reasoning.
The CoT rationales are deterministically generated from structured simulator metadata using task-specific templates, while GPT-4 OpenAI (2023) is used only to paraphrase question wording.
These rationales expose task-specific intermediate cues beyond the final answer, such as sound event identity, source location, visibility checks, distance comparisons, and how source direction and distance change under transformed viewpoints.
This supervision encourages the model to connect auditory, spatial, and visual cues through explicit intermediate reasoning steps rather than directly predicting the final answer.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步提供了全心全意地平地和空间关系推理的连锁解答变体。
CoT原理是用特定任务模板从结构化的模拟元数据中决定性地生成的,而GPT-4 OpenAI (2023)仅用于解释提问措辞.
这些原理暴露出任务特定中间提示超越了最终答案,如声音事件身份,源位置,能见度检查,距离比较,以及源方向和距离变化在转变后的观点下是如何发生的.
这种监督鼓励模型通过明确的中间推理步骤来连接听觉,空间和视觉提示,而不是直接预测最终答案.

blocks.en:
Figure 3: Architecture and training curriculum of HLR-LLM. (a) HLR-LLM augments a strong AV-LLM with a binaural spatial audio branch, enabling the language model to jointly attend to text, visual, downmixed monaural audio, and binaural spatial audio tokens.
(b) The model is trained through a three-stage curriculum: spatial audio alignment, spatial audio-visual instruction tuning, and final-stage CoT tuning for structured spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh:
图3:HLR-LLM的建筑和培训课程。 (a) HLR-LLM用双相空间音频分支扩充了强大的AV-LLM,使语言模型能够共同处理文本、视觉、下同的一相空间音频和二相空间音频符号。
(b) 国家 该模型通过一个三阶段课程培训:空间音频对接,空间视听教学调和,以及结构化空间推理的最后阶段CoT调.

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en:
We introduce HLR-LLM for spatial audio-visual scene understanding.
Our goal is to enable spatial audio-visual grounding and reasoning with binaural spatial cues while retaining the semantic perception ability of a strong base AV-LLM.
To this end, HLR-LLM introduces a spatial audio pathway to the base AV-LLM, where a spatial audio encoder and projector provide binaural spatial cues alongside visual context and monaural semantic audio.
We train the model with a curriculum that incorporates chain-of-thought supervision to guide multi-step spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍HLR-LLM用于空间视听场景理解.
我们的目标是使空间视听地面和推理能够使用二元空间提示,同时保留强大的AV-LLM的语义感知能力。
为此,HLR-LLM引入了通向基础AV-LLM的空间音频路径,空间音频编码器和投影仪在视觉上下文和单相语义音频的同时提供双相空间提示.
我们用包含思维链监督的课程来培训模型,以指导多步骤的空间推理。

blocks.en: 4.1 HLR-LLM architecture
blocks.zh: 4.1 HLR-LLM架构

blocks.en:
Figure 3 (a) shows the architecture of HLR-LLM.
The model consists of the base visual and monaural audio encoders, a newly introduced spatial audio encoder, a lightweight spatial audio projector, and the language model.
The monaural audio branch preserves semantic hearing abilities, such as sound event recognition and speech understanding, while the spatial audio branch provides direction- and distance-sensitive cues for grounding and reasoning.
The language model integrates visual, monaural audio, spatial audio, and text tokens to generate task-specific responses.
blocks.zh:
图3(a)显示HLR-LLM的结构。
该模型由基站视觉和元站音频编码器,新引进的空间音频编码器,轻量级空间音频投影器,语言模型等组成.
修道会音频分支保留了语义听觉能力,如声音事件识别和语音理解等,而空间音频分支则提供方向和对距离敏感的提示来进行地平和推理.
语言模型融合了视觉,寺院音频,空间音频,和文本符号,生成任务特定响应.

(2024) and map the resulting features into the language model embedding space using a trainable MLP projector p spa p_{\mathrm{spa}} : Z spa = p spa ​ ( f spa ​ ( b ) ) . Z_{\mathrm{spa}}=p_{\mathrm{spa}}(f_{\mathrm{spa}}(b)). The projected embeddings Z spa Z_{\mathrm{spa}} serve as spatial audio tokens that provide acoustic localization cues to the LLM.

We build HLR-LLM on Qwen2.5-Omni Xu et al. (2025a) , which supports text, image, and audio inputs. We introduce a new media token, <spatial_audio> , whose placeholder positions are replaced with the projected spatial audio tokens Z spa Z_{\mathrm{spa}} .
The resulting multimodal input sequence is X = [ E ⁡ ( q ) , Z vis , Z aud , Z spa ] , X=[E(q),Z_{\mathrm{vis}},Z_{\mathrm{aud}},Z_{\mathrm{spa}}], where E ⁡ ( q ) E(q) denotes text embeddings, Z vis Z_{\mathrm{vis}} visual tokens, Z aud Z_{\mathrm{aud}} monaural audio tokens, and Z spa Z_{\mathrm{spa}} spatial audio tokens. The language model generates the answer y y conditioned on this sequence, i.e ., p ⁡ ( y ∣ X ) p(y\mid X) .
This design preserves the base model’s semantic audio-visual ability while explicitly injecting spatial acoustic cues.
blocks.zh:

由此产生的多模式输入序列为 X = [ E (q), Z 相对于 z aud, Z spar], Z + mathrm{ vis , Z + mathrm{ ad}}, Z + q mathrm{ spa}}],其中 E → (q) E (q) 表示文本嵌入, Z 对 Z + mathrm{ 相对于 }} 视觉符号, Z aud Z + mathrm{ aud}} monaural 音频符号,和 Z s s → spara 空间音频符号. 语言模型生成以此序列为条件的答案 y ,即 p ⁡ (y ∣ X) p (y\mid X).
这种设计保留了基础模型的语义视听能力,同时明确注入了空间相声提示.

blocks.en: 4.2 Curriculum training for spatial audio-visual reasoning
blocks.zh: 4.2 空间视听推理课程培训

blocks.en:
Spatial audio-visual scene understanding requires low-level perception of what is heard and where it comes from, as well as high-level spatial reasoning over the scene.
Figure 3 (b) summarizes the three-stage curriculum used to train HLR-LLM, which progresses from spatial audio alignment to spatial audio-visual instruction tuning and final-stage CoT tuning.
blocks.zh:
空间视听场景理解要求低水平地感知所听到的和它来自何处,以及对场景的高水平空间推理.
图3(b)概述了用于HLR-LLM培训的三阶段课程,该课程从空间音频对接到空间视听教学调和和最后阶段CoT调和。

blocks.en:
We first pretrain the spatial audio projector using a spatial audio-only QA dataset Zheng et al. (2024) .
This aligns frozen spatial audio encoder features with the LLM embedding space and initializes the model to verbalize spatial audio properties, such as sound event and location.
blocks.zh:
我们首先使用空间音频 QA 数据集对空间音频投影仪进行预演 郑等 (2024).
这使得被冻结的空间音频编码器特征与LLM嵌入空间相匹配,并初始化了模型来将空间音频属性,如声音事件和位置等语言化.

blocks.en: We then fine-tune the model on the training split of HLR-AVSceneQA. This stage teaches the model to jointly use visual tokens, monaural audio tokens, and spatial audio tokens across spatial hearing, grounding, and relational reasoning tasks. For example, recognizing a ringing sound can rely on the monaural audio branch, while determining whether the source is visible or hidden requires combining spatial cues with visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 然后对HLR-AVSceneQA的训练分拆模型进行微调. 这个舞台教导模型联合使用视觉活符,寺院活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体 例如,识别出振铃音可以依赖寺院音源分支,同时确定源是可见的还是隐藏的需要将空间提示与视觉证据相结合.

blocks.en:
Finally, we continue instruction tuning with CoT-formatted answers for multi-step spatial tasks.
The model learns to produce a compact rationale that connects auditory cues, spatial estimates, and visual evidence before giving a normalized final answer.
This encourages
the model
to decompose spatial audio-visual queries into interpretable reasoning steps rather than relying on direct answer prediction.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们继续用协同格式的答案指导多步骤空间任务。
该模型在给出一个正常化的最后答案之前,学会产生一个紧凑的原理,将听觉提示,空间估计和视觉证据联系起来.
这鼓励
模式
将空间视听查询分解为可解释的推理步骤,而不是依赖直接的答案预测.

blocks.en:
At each stage, we minimize the standard auto-regressive cross-entropy loss over the target answer tokens.
Stage 1 updates only the spatial audio projector, while Stages 2–3 update the spatial audio projector and LoRA parameters of the language model.
All visual, monaural audio, and spatial audio encoders remain frozen throughout training.
blocks.zh:
在每个阶段,我们都会将标准自动回转的交叉回转损失最小化于目标答录符.
第1阶段只更新了空间音频投影仪,而第2-3阶段则更新了语言模型的空间音频投影仪和LORA参数.
所有视觉、修道和空间音频编码器在整个培训期间一直被冻结。

blocks.en: 4.3 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 4.3 详细执行情况

blocks.en:
We follow the audio preprocessing of BAT Zheng et al. (2024) . Each source clip is loudness-normalized and convolved with the room impulse response generated by SoundSpaces to produce binaural audio. The resulting two-channel waveform is sampled at 32 kHz. We use a window size of 1024, a hop size of 320, and 128 mel bins to compute spectrogram features. The spatial audio branch receives the binaural signal, while the monaural audio branch receives its channel-averaged version. For visual and monaural audio inputs, we use the default preprocessing of Qwen2.5-Omni without modification.
For LoRA fine-tuning, we use rank 16, alpha 16, dropout 0.05, a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , and weight decay of 0.01. We train for 2 epochs on four NVIDIA A6000 GPUs with a per-device batch size of 4.
blocks.zh:
我们跟踪BAT郑等的音频预处理(2024年). 每个源片段都是高音常态化的并会与SoundSpaces产生的房间冲动响应相接来产生双音. 由此产生的双通道波形以32千赫为样本. 我们使用1024个窗口大小,320个跳动大小,128个mel bins来计算光谱特性. 空间音频分支接收到双音信号,而寺院音频分支接收到其频道平均版本. 对于视觉和修道的音频输入,我们使用没有修改的Qwen2.5-Omni默认预处理.
对于LORA微调,我们使用排名16,α16,退学0.05,学习率2×10−4 2\times 10×4),体重衰减0.01. 我们在4个NVIDIA A6000 GPU上进行2个世纪的训练,每个装置的批量尺寸为4个.

blocks.en: 5 Experiment
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验装置

blocks.en:
We primarily evaluate models on HLR-AVSceneQA for comprehensive spatial audio-visual scene understanding. Except for far-field ASR, which is evaluated by word error rate (WER), and scene captioning, which is evaluated with CIDEr-D Vedantam et al. (2015) , METEOR Banerjee and Lavie (2005) , and SPIDEr Liu et al. (2017) , all other tasks are evaluated using accuracy. We also construct QA formats on the STARSS23 Shimada et al. (2023) dataset to evaluate adaptation to real-world spatial audio-visual recordings, covering sound event recognition, egocentric direction and distance prediction, and visibility prediction.
We restrict the evaluation to these tasks because STARSS23 does not provide the object- and scene-level annotations required to reliably define hidden-source, allocentric, and other relational reasoning tasks.
All fine-tuned models are trained on the corresponding training split and evaluated on the test split. Unless otherwise noted, we report mean ± \pm standard deviation over three runs.
blocks.zh:
我们主要评价HLR-AVSceneQA上的模型,以全面了解空间视听场景。 除了远地ASR(以字数出错率(WER)来评价)和场景字幕(由CIDER-D Vedantam等(2015),METEOR Banerjee和Lavie(2005),SPIDER Liu等(2017)来评价外,所有其他任务都使用准确性来评价. 我们还在STARSS23 Shimada等人(2023年)的数据集上构建了QA格式,以评价对现实世界空间视听录音的适应性,涵盖声音事件识别,以自我为中心的方向和距离预测以及能见度预测.
我们把评价局限于这些任务,因为STARSS23没有提供可靠地定义隐藏源,同心,以及其他关系推理任务所需的对象和场景级别说明.
所有微调模型都接受相应分解训练,并接受分解试验评价. 除非另有说明,我们报告是指3次运行中 ±\pm 标准偏差。

blocks.en: We compare HLR-LLM with both zero-shot and fine-tuned audio-visual models. For zero-shot evaluation, we consider several open-source AV-LLMs Yao et al. (2024) ; Cheng et al. (2024) ; Tang et al. (2025) ; Xu et al. (2025a) ; Xu et al. (2025b) and commercial models OpenAI (2025) ; Comanici et al. (2025) , which mainly use visual input and monaural audio. We also compare with SAVVY Chen et al. (2025) , which uses multichannel audio but focuses on spatial grounding tasks. For fine-tuned baselines, we initialize Hear You Are LLM Ryu et al. (2026) and Qwen2.5-Omni Xu et al. (2025a) from their respective public checkpoints and fine-tune them on the HLR-AVSceneQA training split. Although Hear You Are LLM is originally trained with panoramic images, we adapt it to the same normal-FOV inputs and HLR-AVSceneQA supervision by fine-tuning its visual pathway, projectors/adapters, and LLM while keeping the audio encoder frozen. We additionally fine-tune a dual-channel variant of Qwen2.5-Omni, which separately encodes the left and right binaural channels through the original audio pathway and feeds both audio token streams to the LLM without an explicit spatial audio branch.
blocks.zh: 我们把HLR-LLM与零镜头和微调的视听模型进行比较. 对于零发评价,我们考虑几种开源AV-LLMs Yao等(2024);Cheng等(2024);Tang等(2025);Xu等(2025a);Xu等(2025b)及商业模型OpenAI(2025);Comanici等(2025),主要使用视觉输入和寺院声. 我们还与SAVVY Chen等人(2025年)相比较,后者使用多频道音频,但侧重于空间地平线任务. 对于经过微调的基线,我们从各自的公共检查站初始化了Hear You Are LLM Ryu等人(2026年)和Qun2.5-Omni Xu等人(2025a年),并在HLR-AVSceneQA训练分出时对其进行微调. 虽然Hear You Are LLM最初是经过全景图像训练的,但我们通过微调其视觉路径,投影器/适应器,以及LLM,同时保持音频编码器被冷冻,使其适应相同的普通-FOV输入和HLR-AVSceneQA监督. 我们还微调了Quen2.5-Omni的双通道变体,该变体通过原声道将左声道和右声道分别编码,并将两个音频符号流输入LLM,没有明确的空间音频分支.

blocks.en: 5.2 Main results on HLR-AVSceneQA
blocks.zh: 5.2 HLR-AVSceneQA的主要结果

blocks.en:
Tables 3 and 4 summarize the main results on HLR-AVSceneQA.
In Table 3 , zero-shot AV-LLMs and commercial models show reasonable spatial hearing ability, but perform poorly on direction and distance grounding, indicating that monaural audio with visual input is insufficient for spatial localization.
Baselines with spatial audio improve some grounding tasks, with SAVVY Chen et al. (2025) performing well on egocentric direction and Hear You Are LLM improving over zero-shot models, but they remain limited in broader grounding and reasoning.
Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Omni, our base model, substantially improves sound-event recognition and spatial grounding, yet accurate localization remains challenging without explicit binaural cues.
Dual-channel Qwen2.5-Omni further improves localization by processing left and right channels separately through the original audio pathway, confirming the value of binaural spatial cues.
HLR-LLM outperforms this baseline across all egocentric and allocentric grounding metrics, demonstrating the benefit of explicitly modeling binaural spatial information rather than exposing the LLM to separate left- and right-channel tokens.
blocks.zh:
表3和4总结了HLR-AVSceneQA的主要结果.
在表3中,零射AV-LLMs和商业模型显示合理的空间听力能力,但在方向和距离地平面上表现不佳,表明带有视觉输入的一元音不足以进行空间局部化.
空间音频基线改进了一些地面任务,包括SAVVY 陈等. (2025年)在以自我为中心的方向上表现良好,"Hear You Are LLM"比零镜头模型改进,但它们在更广阔的地基和推理上仍然有限.
精细调整 Quen2.5-Omni, 我们的基础模型, 大大改进声音事件识别和空间定位, 然而准确的本地化仍然具有挑战性 没有明确的双音提示。
双通道Qwen2.5-Omni通过分别通过原始音频路径处理左右通道,进一步提升了本地化,确认了二元空间提示值.
HLR-LLM在所有自负心和等离心地地平面测量中都超过了这一基线,表明明确模拟二元空间信息的好处,而不是将LLM暴露在分左道和右道的信号上。

blocks.en:
A similar trend appears in Table 4 .
Zero-shot models perform reasonably well on visibility, which can often be inferred from visual evidence, but struggle with tasks requiring spatial alignment and relational reasoning.
Fine-tuned baselines improve substantially, highlighting the importance of task-specific learning for spatial audio-visual understanding.
HLR-LLM achieves the best performance across all spatial relational reasoning tasks and consistently outperforms the dual-channel Qwen2.5-Omni baseline, further supporting the benefit of explicit binaural modeling for scene-level reasoning.
Compared with Hear You Are LLM, HLR-LLM achieves consistent gains across relational reasoning tasks, demonstrating stronger scene-level reasoning beyond source localization.
For scene captioning, HLR-LLM achieves the best SPIDEr score, while dual-channel Qwen2.5-Omni obtains the best CIDEr-D and METEOR scores.
Overall, the results show that explicit spatial audio modeling benefits not only source localization but also reasoning about sound sources in the visual scene.
blocks.zh:
类似趋势见表4。
零镜头模型在能见度上表现得相当好,这种能见度往往可以从视觉证据中推断出来,但与需要空间相接和关系推理的任务相搏.
精细调整的基线大大改进,突出了针对具体任务的学习对空间视听理解的重要性.
HLR-LLM在所有空间关系推理任务中都实现了最佳的性能,并始终超越了双通道的Quen2.5-Omni基线,进一步支持了为场景级推理进行清晰的二元模型化的好处.
与"Hear You Are LLM"相比,HLR-LLM在关系推理任务上取得了一致的收获,显示出超出源地本地化的更强大的场景级推理.
对于场景字幕,HLR-LLM实现最佳SPIDER分数,而双通道的Quen2.5-Omni获得最佳CIDER-D和METEOR分数.
总体而言,结果显示,清晰的空间音频模型不仅有利于源地本地化,而且有利于对视觉场景中声音源的推理.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation study
blocks.zh: 5.3 阅读研究

blocks.en:
Table 5 examines the contribution of each modality and training strategy.
Removing vision (a) still retains egocentric direction and distance performance, since binaural audio provides direct spatial cues.
However, it substantially reduces allocentric grounding and proximity reasoning, where visual object locations are required.
Interestingly, the model without vision still performs relatively well on hidden-source reasoning, suggesting that binaural cues provide useful evidence for distinguishing non-visible source configurations.
The visual-only model (b) performs poorly across most tasks, showing that vision alone is insufficient for reliable sound-source localization, especially when sources are off-screen or hidden.
Removing binaural audio (c) also causes a large drop in grounding tasks, showing that monaural audio lacks the spatial cues needed for accurate localization.
At the same time, its relatively stronger proximity performance suggests that visual context and semantic audio can still support some object-level relational reasoning.
blocks.zh:
表5审查了每种方式和培训战略的贡献。
删除视觉(a)仍保留以自我为中心的方向和距离性能,因为双音提供直接的空间提示.
然而,它大大减少了偏心地平地和相近地平地推理,因为在那里需要视觉物体位置.
有趣的是,没有视觉的模型在隐藏源推理上的表现仍然相对好,这表明二元提示为区分非可见源配置提供了有用的证据.
仅视觉模式(b)在大多数任务中表现不佳,表明光视觉不足以可靠地实现音源本地化,特别是在源被屏外或被隐藏的情况下.
删除双音 (c) 也会导致地平线任务大幅下降,表明一元音缺乏精确本地化所需的空间提示.
同时,它的相对更强的相近性能表明视觉上下文和语义音频仍然可以支持一些对象级的关系推理.

blocks.en: The training ablation shows how each stage contributes to spatial reasoning. Stage-2 training (d), which includes Stages 1–2 but omits CoT tuning, already provides strong performance. Joint training with CoT (e), which mixes Stage-2 instruction data with CoT-formatted data, improves egocentric grounding, correspondence, and hidden-source reasoning, but does not consistently improve all grounding tasks. In contrast, our final model (f), which applies CoT tuning after Stage-2 instruction tuning, performs best across all grounding metrics and most relational reasoning tasks, with clear gains in allocentric grounding, correspondence, and proximity. These gains are most evident on tasks requiring multi-step spatial reasoning, such as transforming viewpoints or comparing object–source relations. Overall, the ablation indicates that binaural audio supports spatial localization, vision supports object-level grounding, and final-stage CoT tuning improves complex spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh: 培训停用表明每个阶段如何促进空间推理。 第2阶段培训(d),包括第1至第2阶段,但不包括CoT调试,已经提供了很强的性能。 与CoT(e)进行联合培训,将阶段二教学数据与CoT格式数据相混合,改进了以自我为中心的地基,通信,并改进了隐藏源推理,但并没有始终如一地改进所有地基任务. 相比之下,我们的最后模型(f)在第二阶段指示后应用CoT调制,在所有地基测量和大多数关系推理任务中表现最好,在多心地地基、函授和相近方面都取得了明显的成果。 这些收益在需要多步空间推理的任务中最为明显,例如转变观点或比较对象-源关系。 总的来说,通缩表示二元音支持空间局部化,视觉支持物体级地平面,而末相相通调能改善复杂的空间推理.

blocks.en: 5.5 Qualitative results
blocks.zh: 5.5 定性结果

blocks.en:
Figure 4 shows representative qualitative results for spatial grounding and relational reasoning.
In the left example, multiple visually similar electric blenders are present, while the sound originates from the front-right direction.
The monaural Qwen2.5-Omni predicts an incorrect direction, whereas models with binaural spatial input (Hear You Are LLM and HLR-LLM) correctly localize the source.
The right example is more challenging because the sounding bird is not visible and must be localized using spatial audio and scene layout.
While Qwen2.5-Omni and Hear You Are LLM incorrectly attribute the source to other non-visible regions, HLR-LLM correctly identifies it as hidden behind the bed.
Together, these examples show that explicit spatial audio cues help HLR-LLM localize sound sources and ground them within visible or hidden regions of the scene.
Further results and analyses across diverse spatial reasoning scenarios are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh:
图4显示了空间地平面和关系推理方面的有代表性的质量结果。
在左起例中,存在多台视觉相近的电气搅拌机,而声音则从前向右方向发来.
修道士Quen2.5-Omni预测方向不正确,而具有二元空间输入的模型(Hear You Are LLM和HLR-LLM)则正确定位了源.
正确的例子更具挑战性,因为探空鸟不可见,必须使用空间音频和场景布局进行局部化.
虽然Quen2.5-Omni and Hear You Are LLM错误地将源归为了其他非可见区域,但HLR-LLM正确地将源归为隐藏在床后.
这些例子一起表明,清晰的空间音频提示有助于HLR-LLM将声音源本地化,并在场景的可见或隐藏区域进行地取地.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and discussion
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和讨论

blocks.en: We introduce HLR-AVSceneQA, a comprehensive benchmark for spatial audio-visual scene understanding organized around a hear-localize-reason hierarchy. By covering spatial hearing, egocentric and allocentric grounding, and spatial relational reasoning, HLR-AVSceneQA evaluates whether AV-LLMs can move beyond recognizing audio-visual content to connect what is heard, where it originates, and how the source relates to the surrounding scene. We also propose HLR-LLM, which augments a strong AV-LLM with a binaural spatial audio branch and a staged curriculum with final-stage CoT supervision, improving spatial reasoning while retaining strong semantic audio-visual perception. Real-world adaptation experiments on STARSS23 further show that HLR-AVSceneQA pretraining provides useful spatial priors for downstream adaptation. These results highlight the importance of explicit spatial audio modeling and structured training for spatially aware AV-LLMs.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍HLR-AVSceneQA,这是围绕听觉本地化-理性分级排列的空间视听场景理解的全面基准. HLR-AVSceneQA通过涵盖空间听觉,自负心地和同心地地定位,以及空间关系推理,评价AV-LLM能否超越识别视听内容,连接所听到的内容,来源地,源与周围场景的关系. 我们还提出HLR-LLM,它用双相空间音频分支和具有最后阶段CoT监督的舞台课程来增强强大的AV-LLM,改善空间推理,同时保留强烈的语义视听感知. STARSS23上的真实世界适应实验进一步显示,HLR-AVSceneQA预训为下游适应提供了有用的空间前兆. 这些成果突出表明了明确空间音频模型和结构化培训对空间意识AV-LLMs的重要性.

blocks.en: Our work also has limitations. HLR-AVSceneQA is built with a simulator-based pipeline, which provides controllable annotations but cannot fully capture the acoustic complexity and visual diversity of the real world. The benchmark focuses on indoor scenes, leaving dynamic agents, moving sound sources, and richer embodied interaction for future work. Future research should extend spatial audio-visual benchmarks to more realistic and dynamic settings and develop AV-LLMs that can actively perceive, move, and reason in spatial environments.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作也有局限性。 HLR- AV 场景 QA是用以模拟器为主的管道来建造的,它提供可控制的说明,但不能完全捕捉现实世界的声学复杂性和视觉多样性. 基准侧重于室内场景,留下活性剂,移动声音源,为未来工作提供更丰富的体现互动. 未来的研究应当将空间视听基准扩大到更现实和动态的环境,并开发能够在空间环境中积极感知、移动和理性的AV-LLMS。

blocks.en: A.1 Implementation details
blocks.zh: A.1 执行细节

blocks.en: HLR-LLM is built on Qwen2.5-Omni with an additional binaural spatial audio pathway. For the spatial branch, we use a pretrained Spatial-AST encoder following BAT [ 9 ] . Spatial-AST produces audio tokens together with class tokens trained for semantic classification, direction prediction, and distance prediction. We use these tokens as spatial audio features and map them into the language embedding space with a lightweight projector. The projector is an MLP with a linear–GELU–linear structure, which has been shown to be effective for extending LLMs to multimodal inputs [ 52 , 53 ] .
blocks.zh: HLR-LLM建于Quen2.5-Omni上,并配有额外的二元空间音频路径. 对于空间分支,我们使用经过预先训练的空间-AST编码器,遵循BAT[9]. Space-AST 制作音频符号,同时制作经过语义分类、方向预测和距离预测培训的类符号。 我们使用这些符号作为空间音频特征,并用轻量级投影仪将其映射入语言嵌入空间. 投影机是一种有线-GELU-线性结构的MLP,它已被证明对将LLMs扩展至多式输入[52,53]有效.

blocks.en: Training follows the three-stage curriculum described in the main paper. In Stage 1, we train only the spatial alignment modules, including the spatial audio resampler and projector, while freezing the language model, visual encoder, monaural audio encoder, and spatial audio encoder. In Stages 2–3, we LoRA-finetune the language model and continue updating the spatial alignment modules while keeping the encoders frozen. We apply LoRA to all linear layers with rank 16, alpha 16, and dropout 0.05, and use LoRA+ with a larger learning-rate ratio for the LoRA B B matrix. We train with bfloat16 precision, FlashAttention, learning rate 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , warmup ratio 0.05, weight decay 0.01, and gradient clipping at 1.0. Training is performed for 2 epochs on four NVIDIA A6000 GPUs with per-device batch size 4 and gradient accumulation 4.
blocks.zh: 培训遵循主要论文所述的三阶段课程。 在第一阶段,我们只培训空间对接模块,包括空间音频再模和投影器,同时冻结语言模型,视觉编码器,寺院音频编码器,以及空间音频编码器. 在阶段2–3中,我们LORA-finetune语言模型,并继续更新空间对接模块,同时使编码器被冻结. 我们把LORA应用到所有16等,α等16等和辍学0.05等的线性地层上,并且使用LORA B矩阵中学习率较大的LORA+. 我们用bfloat16精度,FlashAttention,学习率2×10-4 2\times 10×4},热能比0.05,重量衰减0.01,梯度剪接为1.0. 对4个NVIDIA A6000 GPU进行2个世纪的培训,每个装置批量尺寸4和梯度累积4。

blocks.en: A.2 Details on comparison model experiments
blocks.zh: A.2 比较模型实验的细节

blocks.en:
Since spatial AV-LLMs are still limited, we first evaluate existing AV-LLMs that accept visual input and monaural audio [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 50 , 51 ] .
For these models, the binaural audio is converted to monaural during preprocessing.
For SAVVY [ 13 ] , we follow the official code to process our inputs and evaluate only the applicable spatial grounding tasks, matching the scope of the original paper.
blocks.zh:
由于空间AV-LLMs仍然有限,我们首先评价接受视觉输入和修道声的现有AV-LLMs[1,2,3,4,5,50,51].
对于这些模型,双音在预处理期间被转换为一元音.
对于SAVVY [13],我们遵循官方代码来处理我们的投入,只评价适用的空间地平面任务,与原始文件的范围相匹配.

blocks.en: For fairer comparisons, we additionally fine-tune three baselines using the same direct-answer HLR-AVSceneQA training split.
blocks.zh: 为了进行更公平的比较,我们利用相同的直接回答HLR-AVSceneQA训练分解,对三个基线进行再微调.

blocks.en:
We fine-tune Hear You Are LLM [ 15 ] , the closest existing trainable model that uses both visual input and binaural audio for spatial audio-visual reasoning.
Although it was originally trained with panoramic observations, HLR-AVSceneQA is defined under normal-field-of-view (normal-FOV) inputs, where sources may be visible, occluded, off-screen, or located in another room.
We therefore adapt Hear You Are LLM to the same 1280 × \times 720 normal-FOV images, 32-kHz binaural audio, QA prompts, answer targets, and evaluation protocol used for HLR-LLM.
Its SigLIP image encoder can directly process the normal-FOV images as patch tokens without architectural modification.
During fine-tuning, we apply LoRA to the image encoder (rank 16, alpha 32) and update the projectors/adapters and LLM, while keeping the audio encoder frozen.
We retain the original Hear You Are architecture and do not add the spatial audio branch used in HLR-LLM.
Accordingly, this comparison evaluates two adapted spatial AV-LLMs under matched data and evaluation conditions, rather than providing a fully architecture-matched comparison.
blocks.zh:
我们微调了Hear You Are LLM [15],这是目前最接近的可训练模型,既使用视觉输入,也使用双音来进行空间视听推理.
虽然它最初是经过全景观测训练的,但HLR-AVSceneQA是在正常视野(正常-FOV)输入下被定义的,其中源头可能是可见的,被遮住的,被屏外的,或者位于另一个房间.
因此,我们调整 Hear You Are LLM 以相同的1280x\times 720普通-FOV图像,32-k Hz binaural audio,QA提示,回答目标,以及HLR-LLM所使用的评价协议.
它的SigLIP图像编码器可以直接处理普通-FOV图像作为补丁符号而无需进行建筑修改.
在微调期间,我们将LORA应用到图像编码器上(排名16,α 32)并更新投影仪/调整器和LLM,同时使音频编码器被冻结.
我们保留了原有的Hear You Are架构,不添加HLR-LLM中使用的空间音频分支.
因此,这一比较评价了两个在相匹配的数据和评价条件下经过调整的空间AV-LLMs,而不是提供与结构完全匹配的比较。

blocks.en:
We fine-tune Qwen2.5-Omni [ 4 ] , our monaural-audio base model, on HLR-AVSceneQA.
This provides a controlled baseline for evaluating spatial reasoning without explicit binaural spatial modeling.
blocks.zh:
我们在HLR-AVSceneQA上微调了Quen2.5-Omni [4],我们的寺院-音频基模.
这为评价空间推理提供了控制基线,而不采用明确的二元空间模型。

blocks.en:
We additionally fine-tune a dual-channel variant of Qwen2.5-Omni to test whether simply providing both binaural channels is sufficient for spatial reasoning.
Instead of downmixing the binaural input to mono, the left and right channels are separately encoded through the original monaural audio pathway, and both resulting audio token streams are provided to the LLM.
Unlike HLR-LLM, this variant does not introduce a dedicated spatial audio encoder or spatial projector.
Thus, it isolates the benefit of explicit spatial-audio modeling from simply exposing the base model to both audio channels.
blocks.zh:
我们还对Qun2.5-Omni的双通道变体进行了微调,以测试仅仅提供双通道是否足以进行空间推理。
左声道和右声道不是将双音道输入分解为单音道,而是通过原始的元音道单独编码,两个产生的音符流都提供给了LLM.
与HLR-LLM不同,这个变体没有引入专用的空间音频编码器或空间投影仪.
因此,它将清晰的空间-音频模型的好处从简单地将基模型暴露在两个音频通道上隔离出.

blocks.en: A.3 STARSS23 preprocessing and QA construction
blocks.zh: A.3 STARSS23预处理和质量保证建造

blocks.en:
STARSS23 [ 19 ] is an audio-visual dataset of real-world spatial recordings with synchronized video, first-order ambisonic (FOA) audio, and frame-level spatio-temporal annotations of sound events.
We use STARSS23 as a real-world benchmark complementary to our simulator-generated HLR-AVSceneQA.
Starting from the official STARSS23 development split, we follow the official train/test partition and divide each recording into non-overlapping 10-second clips.
Clips without a corresponding video stream are removed, resulting in 1,317 train clips and 1,116 test clips.
For each clip, we extract a rectilinear egocentric image from the midpoint video frame.
We also convert the FOA audio into binaural audio using the CIPIC subject-048 HRTF convention [ 54 ] .
This makes the real-world recordings compatible with the binaural audio interface used by our spatial audio-visual models while retaining the original STARSS23 annotations.
blocks.zh:
STARSS23 [19]是一款真实世界空间录音的视听数据集,内容包括同步视频,一阶相声(FOA)音频,以及帧级相声-时态相声事件说明.
我们使用STARSS23作为现实世界基准,作为我们模拟器生成的HLR-AVSceneQA的补充.
从STARSS23正式开发分出开始,我们跟随正式的列车/测试分区,将每段录音分出为非重叠的10秒片段.
没有相应视频流的剪接被取出,导致1,317个列车夹和1,116个测试夹.
对于每个片段,我们从中点视频框中提取出一幅直线自负中心图像.
我们还利用CIPIC主题048HRTF常规[54]将FOA音频转换为双音.
这使得现实世界的录音与我们空间视听模型使用的双音相容,同时保留了STARSS23原作的注释.

blocks.en:
We convert STARSS23 azimuth annotations into our egocentric convention, where 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} is front, 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} is right, 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} is back, and 270 ∘ 270^{\circ} is left.
We construct QA pairs for sound-event recognition, egocentric direction prediction, egocentric distance prediction, and visibility prediction.
We distinguish static and dynamic sources using angular and distance variation of active annotation frames, and use only static sources for spatial QA.
Following psychoacoustic studies of auditory motion and distance discrimination [ 55 , 56 ] , a source is treated as static when its angular variation is within 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} and its relative distance variation is within 20 % 20\% .
blocks.zh:
我们把STARSS23的方位说明转换成我们以自我为中心的会议,其中0 0^{\0^{\Circ}为前作,90∘90^{\Crc}为正作,180∘180^{\Crc}为后作,270∘270∘270^{\Crc}为左作.
我们构建了QA对,用于声音事件识别,自我中心方向预测,自我中心距离预测和能见度预测.
我们利用活性注解框架的角和相差变化来区分静态和动态源,并且只使用静态源进行空间QA.
在对听觉运动和距离歧视进行心理声学研究[55,56]之后,当一个源的角变值在5 ∘ 5 ^{\ Circ] 以静态处理,而它的相对距离变值在20% 20 \%以内.

blocks.en:
For each retained static source, we compute representative azimuth and distance values from its active annotation frames and discretize them into the same egocentric bins used in HLR-AVSceneQA.
We remove ambiguous QA items, including cases where frame-level annotations cross bin boundaries or multiple same-class sources make the queried source unclear.
Since STARSS23 does not provide object-level semantic masks, visibility is defined geometrically by whether the representative source direction falls inside the canonical rectilinear camera field of view.
blocks.zh:
对于每个保留了的静态源,我们从它的活性注解框中计算出代表方位角和相距值,并将其盘式为HLR-AVSceneQA中使用的同一种自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取自取
我们删除模棱两可的质量保证项目,包括帧级注释跨越bin边界或多个同级源导致被询问源不明确的情况.
由于STARSS23不提供对象级语义口罩,所以能见度通过代表源方向是否落在犬形直线相机视域内来几何定义.

blocks.en:
We restrict the real-world evaluation to tasks that can be reliably derived from STARSS23 annotations.
STARSS23 does not provide the dense object- and scene-level annotations required for HLR-style hidden-source or allocentric grounding, including object geometry, occlusion state, room layout, and reference-object information.
We therefore avoid constructing uncertain pseudo-labels for these unsupported tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们把现实世界的评价限于从STARSS23说明中可以可靠地得出的任务.
STARSS23不提供HLR风格的隐藏源或多心地平地所需的密集对象和场景级说明,包括对象几何,被隔离状态,房间布局,和参考对象信息等.
因此,我们避免为这些得不到支持的任务制造不确定的假标签。

blocks.en: B.1 Ablation study
blocks.zh: B.1 读取研究

blocks.en:
Tables S1 and S2 provide the full ablation results on HLR-AVSceneQA.
The modality ablation shows that binaural audio is essential for spatial grounding.
Removing the binaural pathway in (c) substantially degrades egocentric and allocentric grounding as well as spatial relational reasoning. The visual-only variant (b) also performs poorly across these tasks.
In contrast, removing monaural audio in (d) has a smaller effect on spatial grounding, but severely degrades far-field speech recognition, highlighting the role of the monaural pathway in preserving semantic audio understanding.
blocks.zh:
表S1和S2提供了HLR-AVSceneQA的全部衰减结果.
模式衰减表明,双音对空间地平面至关重要.
消除(c)中的二元路径会大大地降低自我中心、多相中心地基以及空间关系推理。 仅可视化的变体(b)在完成这些任务方面也表现不佳。
相形之下,去除(d)中的修道声对空间地平面影响较小,但严重地贬低了远地语音识别,突出了修道道道在保存语义音频理解方面的作用.

blocks.en:
The data-scale ablation in (e)–(g) further disentangles the effect of training data from explicit spatial audio modeling.
Even with only 10% of the training data, (e) substantially outperforms the 100%-data model without binaural audio (c) on egocentric grounding and most relational reasoning tasks.
Increasing the training data generally improves spatial reasoning, particularly relational reasoning and scene captioning, although some grounding tasks exhibit non-monotonic variation.
blocks.zh:
(e)-(g)中的数据尺度衰减进一步将培训数据的效果从明确的空间音频模型中分离出来。
即使只有10%的培训数据,(e) 在无双相声(c)的情况下,在自我中心定位和大多数关系推理任务上,大大超过了100%的数据模型。
增加培训数据一般会改善空间推理,特别是关系推理和场景字幕,尽管一些地面任务显示出非模拟变化。

blocks.en:
The training ablation compares Stage-2 training (g), joint training (h), and our final staged curriculum with CoT tuning (i).
Final-stage CoT tuning improves both egocentric and allocentric grounding and achieves the strongest performance on most relational reasoning tasks, with particularly clear gains in correspondence and proximity.
The CoT supervision explicitly exposes intermediate steps, such as identifying the sound event, estimating the source location, transforming viewpoints, and comparing source–object relations, which helps the model decompose complex spatial queries before predicting the final answer.
We also observe that CoT tuning degrades scene captioning metrics and far-field ASR, suggesting a trade-off between structured multi-step reasoning and tasks that primarily require direct semantic prediction.
Overall, we select (i), which uses all modalities and final-stage CoT tuning, as our final model.
blocks.zh:
培训计划将第二阶段培训(g),联合培训(h),以及我们最后的阶段课程与综合培训调整(i)相比较。
最终阶段的CoT调制改进了以自负为中心与以同心为中心地平地,并在大多数关系推理任务上取得了最强的性能,在函授和相近性上特别明显得分.
CoT监督明确暴露出中间步骤,如识别声音事件,估计源位置,转变观点,并比较源-对象关系等,这有助于模型在预测最终答案之前分解复杂的空间查询.
我们还注意到,CoT调制可降解场景字幕的度量衡和远地ASR,建议在结构化多步骤推理和主要需要直接语义预测的任务之间取舍.
总体而言,我们选择(一),即使用所有模式和最后阶段CoT调制,作为我们的最终模式。

blocks.en: B.2 Analysis on the STARSS23 dataset

blocks.en:
Table S3 evaluates direct transfer from HLR-AVSceneQA to real-world STARSS23 recordings without target-domain fine-tuning.
Despite being trained only on simulated scenes, HLR-LLM outperforms existing AV-LLMs on direction, distance, and visibility prediction, with particularly notable gains in distance estimation.
Although sound recognition remains less competitive, these results suggest that spatial grounding capabilities learned from HLR-AVSceneQA can transfer to real-world recordings without target-domain supervision.
blocks.zh:
表S3评价从HLR-AVSceneQA直接传输到现实世界的STARSS23录音而不进行目标域微调.
尽管只接受了模拟场景方面的培训,但HLR-LLM在方向、距离和能见度预测方面超过了现有的AV-LLMs,在距离估计方面取得了特别显著的进展。
虽然声音识别的竞争力仍然较低,但这些结果表明从HLR-AVSceneQA学得的空间定位能力可以在没有目标领域监督的情况下转移到现实世界的录音.

blocks.en: B.3 Qualitative results
blocks.zh: B.3 定性结果

blocks.en:
We present qualitative chain-of-thought (CoT) examples from HLR-AVSceneQA in Figure S1 .
The examples focus on spatial relational reasoning, where HLR-LLM explicitly decomposes the problem into sound-source localization and subsequent reasoning over visible objects.
In the proximity example, Qwen2.5-Omni selects the drum, whereas HLR-LLM’s CoT first estimates the sound-source location and candidate-object positions, compares their distances to the source, and correctly identifies the child as the closest object.
In the correspondence example, Qwen2.5-Omni incorrectly selects a visible saxophone.
HLR-LLM’s CoT instead localizes the sounding saxophone to the front-left, compares this position with the visible candidates, and correctly concludes that none of them is spatially aligned with the sound.
These examples illustrate how CoT supervision enables HLR-LLM to explicitly connect sound-source localization with downstream scene-level relational reasoning.

这些例子说明了CoT监管如何使HLR-LLM能够将声音源本地化与下游场景级关系推理明确联系起来.

blocks.en: Figure S4: Counterfactual analysis with conflicting audio-visual cues. The image is kept fixed with the dog visible at its original location, while the binaural source position is changed. HLR-LLM follows the counterfactual spatial audio and correspondingly updates its localization and downstream loudness reasoning.
blocks.zh: 图S4:与相冲突的视听提示进行反事实分析. 图像被固定在狗在原位置可见处,而双音源位置被改变. HLR-LLM遵循反事实空间音频,并相应更新其本地化和下游高音推理.

blocks.en: We also provide failure cases in Fig. S3 . Most errors are caused by fine-grained spatial ambiguity. For example, the model may confuse adjacent direction labels, such as back-right vs. right or front-left vs. left , especially when the source lies near a bin boundary. Errors also occur when several candidate objects are spatially clustered, making it difficult to associate the localized sound with the correct object. In multi-source scenes, failures often arise when two sources are close to each other and the non-target source is louder. In such cases, overlapping acoustic cues can dominate the prediction, causing the model to localize or reason about the wrong source.
blocks.zh: 我们还提供S3图中的失败案例。 大多数出错都是由细纹的空间模糊所造成. 例如,模型可能会混淆相邻的方向标签,如后向右对右或前向左对左等. 特别是当源位于一个宾边界附近时. 当几个候选对象在空间上被集群时也会出现出错,使得本地化的声音难以与正确的对象联系起来. 在多源场景中,当两个来源相近,而非目标来源更响亮时,往往会出现故障. 在这种情况下,相重叠的相声提示可以支配预测,使模型对错误来源进行本地化或解释.

blocks.en:
We further conduct a counterfactual analysis to examine whether HLR-LLM relies on spatial audio cues when visual and auditory evidence conflict.
We keep the rendered image fixed, where the dog remains visible at its original location, and replace the binaural audio with dog barking rendered from different spatial positions.
As shown in Fig. S4 , HLR-LLM follows the counterfactual spatial audio in both cases.
In the left case, it localizes the barking to the front-left at 0.9 m and infers that moving to the radiator increases the source distance, resulting in a quieter prediction.
In the right case, it instead localizes the barking to the front at 4.1 m and predicts that moving to the step brings the agent closer to the source, resulting in a louder prediction, even though the visible dog remains at its original front-left location.
These results provide evidence that HLR-LLM uses spatial audio for localization and subsequent spatial reasoning rather than relying solely on the visible source position.

blocks.en: C.1 Scene initialization, agent placement, and scene generation
blocks.zh: 页:1 场景初始化、代理放置和场景生成

blocks.en: We generate each sample in Habitat-Sim with acoustic rendering using the SoundSpaces simulator [ 16 ] . The agent is initialized with synchronized RGB, semantic, depth, panoramic RGB, and binaural audio sensors. The RGB sensor is a pinhole camera used as the main visual input. The semantic and depth sensors are used for visibility checking and geometric supervision, while the panoramic RGB sensor is used for visualization and debugging. The binaural audio sensor is co-located with the visual agent and uses a two-channel receiver at a 32 kHz sampling rate with material-aware indirect propagation. We set the sensor height to 150 cm and the camera field of view to 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} .
blocks.zh: 我们利用声空间模拟器 以声波渲染生成生境-西姆的每个样本 [16]. 该剂被初始化,有同步的RGB,语义,深度,全景RGB,和双音传感器. RGB传感器是用作主要视觉输入的针孔相机. 语义和深度传感器用于能见度检查和几何监督,而全景RGB传感器用于可视化和调试. 双音感应器与视觉特效合用并用双通道接收器,采样率为32千赫,有物质意识的间接传播. 我们把传感器高度设定为150公分 镜头视野设定为90分90分

blocks.en: We select valid rooms from HM3D scenes [ 39 ] by checking that the semantic region contains a floor, a valid room-level region of interest, and sufficient navigable positions. In the standard setting, we place the agent near a room corner and orient it toward the room center, which increases the chance that inserted objects and room semantics are visible. Since this placement may bias sound sources toward the front view, we also sample agent poses closer to the room center. This makes it possible to construct scenes in which one reference object remains visible while another object or sound source falls outside the camera view.
blocks.zh: 我们从HM3D场景[39]中选择有效的房间,通过检查语义区包含一个楼层,一个有效的房间级别感兴趣的区域,以及足够的可航行位置. 在标准设定中,我们把毒剂放在一个房间角落附近,并把它指向房间中心,这增加了插入的物体和房间语义可见的可能性. 由于这种放置可能使声音源偏向于前视线,所以我们也把样品剂放在更靠近房间中心的地方. 这使得可以构造一个参考对象仍然可见,而另一个对象或声音源则会掉入相机视图外的场景.

blocks.en: We use Habitat coordinates for camera, agent, and source placement, and convert positions into metric distances when constructing QA labels. For azimuth, we annotate angles around the horizontal plane, ranging from 0 to 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} . In our setup, 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} indicates the front direction, 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} indicates the right direction, 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} indicates the back direction, and 270 ∘ 270^{\circ} indicates the left direction relative to the agent. We do not consider elevation in this manuscript, as human spatial-audio localization is generally known to be more accurate and robust in azimuth than in elevation [ 57 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们使用栖息地坐标进行相机、剂和源位定位,并在构建QA标签时将位置转换为公尺距离。 对于方位角,我们用字母标出横向平面的角,从0到360~360~Circ}. 在我们的设定中,0分表示前方方向,90分表示后方方向,180分表示后方方向,270分表示后方方向,270分表示后方方向,相对代理人而言是左方方向. 我们并不认为这一手稿中存在高地,因为众所周知,在方位比高地更准确和稳健。

blocks.en: We insert 3D object meshes into HM3D rooms to synthesize controlled layouts containing both sounding and non-sounding objects. The object pool is built from curated meshes, including Objaverse-XL assets [ 43 ] , as well as generated meshes for sound categories whose object coverage is insufficient. For generated sounding-object meshes, we first use Stable Diffusion 2 [ 44 ] for text-to-image synthesis, and then use TRELLIS [ 45 ] for image-to-3D mesh generation. The size and brightness of each object category are manually determined to ensure plausible rendering in indoor scenes. Examples are shown in Fig. S6 .
blocks.zh: 我们在HM3D室中插入了3D对象中间膜来合成包含有声和无声物体的受控布局. 对象池由被曲解的网格所建,包括Objaverse-XL资产[43],以及生成的网格用于对象覆盖不足的音类. 对于生成的发音-对象元件,我们首先使用"稳定分化"2 [44]进行文字到图像合成,然后使用TRELLIS [45]进行图像到3D网格生成. 每一类物体的大小和亮度由人工确定,以确保在室内场景中进行可信的渲染。 例子见图S6。

blocks.en: When inserting objects into a room, we reject placements that collide with room geometry, overlap existing objects above a horizontal IoU threshold, or violate minimum agent-to-object or object-to-object distance constraints. These filtering steps help ensure that inserted objects are physically plausible and visually distinguishable.

blocks.en: We intentionally include several scenarios that require audio-visual spatial reasoning beyond semantic matching. Occluded sound sources place the active source behind a visible object or behind a wall, so the source may project into the camera view while having no visible semantic pixels. Ambiguous sound sources among same-category instances include multiple objects of the same category, requiring the model to determine which instance is spatially aligned with the sound. Semantically mismatched but spatially aligned cases attach a sound event to an object that does not semantically match the event, preventing models from relying only on category correspondence. Adjacent-room sound sources move the source into a neighboring room connected through the scene geometry, creating cases where the source is not visible but can still be heard from a distant location.

blocks.en: Here we provide additional details on the task definitions, their descriptions, and the intention of each task, using the example in Fig. S7 . In this scenario, Fig. S7 (a) shows the agent’s view, which is the model input with a normal field of view. Several instances are inserted, including a dog, a piano, a baby, and two alarm clocks. There are two sound events: one is a man speaking, saying “Turn off the alarm,” coming from the agent’s front-left direction and originating from an adjacent room. The other is an alarm ringing from the blue alarm clock, coming from the front direction, 3.4 meters away. Based on this example, we describe the goal and intended evaluation behavior of each task.
blocks.zh: 在此,我们以图S7为例,就任务定义、其说明以及每项任务的意图提供其他细节。 在此情景下,Fig.S7(a)显示代理的观点,即具有正常视野的模型输入. 插入了几个例子,包括一只狗、一个钢琴、一个婴儿和两个闹钟。 有两个声音事件:一个是说 " 关闭警报器 " 的人,来自特工的左前方,来自相邻的房间。 另一个是从蓝色的闹钟响起的警报,从3.4米外的前方方向来. 基于这个例子,我们描述了每项任务的目标和预期的评价行为。

blocks.en: Furthermore, to improve linguistic diversity and reduce overfitting to fixed question formats, we generate paraphrased templates for each task. We create approximately 15 paraphrases per task and show three representative prompts below. The full set of templates will be included in the dataset release.
blocks.zh: 此外,为了提高语言多样性并减少过于适合固定问题格式的情况,我们为每项任务生成简化模板。 我们为每项任务创造了大约15个句子,下面显示三个有代表性的提示。 整套模板将纳入数据集发布.

blocks.en: This task evaluates semantic audio perception. The model is asked to identify the audible sound event from a set of candidate sound categories. A total of 10 candidate sound categories are provided as options. The target sound category is always included, while distractors are sampled from semantically related categories, sound categories associated with scene objects, and random categories. When multiple sources are present, the prompt may additionally specify the source direction and distance to indicate which source should be recognized. • Q: What sound do you hear from the front, 3.4 meters away? • A: alarm clock ringing. • Paraphrase 1: Which sound is coming from the front, 3.4 meters away? • Paraphrase 2: Identify the sound event from the front direction at 3.4 meters.
blocks.zh: 此任务评价语义音频感知. 要求该模型从一组候选声音类别中识别出可听出的声音事件. 共有10个候选声音类别作为选项提供。 目标声音类总是包含在内,而分光器则取自与分光相关的类别,与场景对象相关的声音类,以及随机类. 当存在多个源时,提示符可能额外指定出源方向和距离,以表示应当识别出哪个源. • 问:你从3.4米外的前面听到什么声音? • A:闹钟响起。 · 第1句:从3.4米外的前方发出出哪些声音? • 第2句:从前向3.4米处识别出声音事件。

blocks.en: Q: What sound do you hear from the front, 3.4 meters away?
blocks.zh: 问:你从3.4米外的前方听到什么声音?

blocks.en: A: alarm clock ringing.
blocks.zh: A:闹钟响起。

blocks.en: Paraphrase 1: Which sound is coming from the front, 3.4 meters away?
blocks.zh: 语句 1: 从3.4米外的前方传来出出哪些声音?

blocks.en: Paraphrase 2: Identify the sound event from the front direction at 3.4 meters.
blocks.zh: 语句 2:在3.4米处从前方方向识别出声音事件.

blocks.en: This task evaluates far-field automatic speech recognition (ASR) from spatialized audio. Since speech may contain important information that the agent should understand, the model is required to recognize speech as part of spatial hearing. Because speech can originate from both nearby and distant locations, far-field ASR is more challenging than clean or near-field ASR. We ask the model to return only the exact quoted transcription, without any additional explanation. • Q: Transcribe what the person said. Output only the transcription inside quotes. • A: “Turn off the alarm.” • Paraphrase 1: Write the exact phrase spoken. Return only the quoted transcription. • Paraphrase 2: Provide the exact spoken words inside quotes.
blocks.zh: 这项任务从空间化音频评价远地自动语音识别(ASR). 由于语音可能包含代理人应当理解的重要信息,该模型必须识别语音作为空间听觉的一部分. 由于语音既可以来自附近地点,也可以来自遥远的地点,远地ASR比干净或近地ASR更具挑战性. 我们要求模型只归还确切引用的抄本,而不作任何补充解释。 • 问题:转述此人所说的话。 仅输出内出引文中的转录. • A:“关闭警报器”。 • 口语 1:写准确的口语. 只归还所引用的抄本。 • 第2句:提供引文中准确的口语。

blocks.en: Q: Transcribe what the person said. Output only the transcription inside quotes.
blocks.zh: 问:转述此人所言. 仅输出内出引文中的转录.

blocks.en: A: “Turn off the alarm.”
blocks.zh: 回答:“关掉警报。 “

blocks.en: Paraphrase 1: Write the exact phrase spoken. Return only the quoted transcription.
blocks.zh: 语句 1:写准确的口语. 只归还所引用的抄本。

blocks.en: Paraphrase 2: Provide the exact spoken words inside quotes.
blocks.zh: 语句 2:提供引文中准确的口语.

blocks.en: This task evaluates egocentric sound-source direction estimation. The answer is computed from the vector pointing from the agent to the sound source, with its azimuth measured relative to the agent’s current forward direction. We ask the model to answer using a discretized 8-bin azimuth label as shown in Table S4 . If multiple sources are present, we specify the queried sound source. • Q: From this camera perspective, which direction bin does the source of alarm clock ringing fall into? • A: front. • Paraphrase 1: Based on the current view, which direction is the alarm clock ringing coming from? • Paraphrase 2: From this viewpoint, identify the direction bin for the source of alarm clock ringing.
blocks.zh: 这项任务评价了以自我为中心的声音源方向估计. 答案是从介质到声音源的向量计算出来的,其方位角相对于介质当前前进方向进行测量。 如表S4所示,我们要求模型使用盘状8-宾方位角标签进行回答。 如果存在多个源, 我们指定被询问的音源 。 • 问:从这个相机的角度来看,响铃的源头是哪个方向? • A:前方。 • 第2句:从这个角度,确定报警钟铃声源的方向。

blocks.en: Q: From this camera perspective, which direction bin does the source of alarm clock ringing fall into?
blocks.zh: 问:从这个相机的角度来看,响铃的源头是哪个方向的?

blocks.en: A: front.
blocks.zh: 甲:前相会.

blocks.en: Paraphrase 1: Based on the current view, which direction is the alarm clock ringing coming from?
blocks.zh: 语句 1:根据目前的观点,闹钟从哪个方向响起?

blocks.en: Paraphrase 2: From this viewpoint, identify the direction bin for the source of alarm clock ringing.
blocks.zh: 语句 2: 从这个角度, 确定闹钟源的方向框 。

blocks.en: This task evaluates egocentric source-distance estimation. The answer is computed as the horizontal distance between the agent and the active sound source, and is then converted into a discrete distance bin, as shown in Table S4 . If multiple sources are present, we specify the queried sound source. • Q: From this camera perspective, what is the distance to the source of alarm clock ringing? • A: F. • Paraphrase 1: Based on the current view, how far away is the source of alarm clock ringing? • Paraphrase 2: From this viewpoint, select the distance bin for the source of alarm clock ringing.
blocks.zh: 这项任务评价了以自我为中心的源-距离估计。 如表S4所显示,答案是作为代理人与活性声音源之间的水平距离来计算的,然后被转换成离散相距宾. 如果存在多个源, 我们指定被询问的音源 。 • 问:从这个相机的角度来看,警报钟响起的源头距离是多少? 二. 支助 A:F. • 第1句:根据目前的观点,警报钟的震源有多远? • 第2句:从这个角度选择报警钟铃声源的相距宾。

blocks.en: Q: From this camera perspective, what is the distance to the source of alarm clock ringing?
blocks.zh: 问:从这个相机的角度来看,响起闹钟的源头距离是多少?

blocks.en: A: F.
blocks.zh: 亚:F.

blocks.en: Paraphrase 1: Based on the current view, how far away is the source of alarm clock ringing?
blocks.zh: 语句 1:根据目前的观点,警报钟的震源有多远?

blocks.en: Paraphrase 2: From this viewpoint, select the distance bin for the source of alarm clock ringing.
blocks.zh: 语句 2: 从这个角度看, 选择一个距离框来显示闹钟铃声的来源 。

blocks.en: This task evaluates direction reasoning from a different viewpoint. The prompt asks the model to imagine standing at a reference object and facing another object, as shown in Fig. S7 (b). The source direction is then recomputed in this new coordinate frame. It is intended to evaluate whether the model can reason from a different perspective and understand the 3D spatial structure of the current scene. The task is generated only when valid visible reference and facing objects are available. We avoid prompts where the reference and facing objects have identical final category names, which would make the instruction ambiguous. As in the egocentric case, the answer is a discretized 8-bin azimuth label. If multiple sources are present, we specify the queried sound source. • Q: If you stand by the piano facing the baby, which direction is the source of alarm clock ringing coming from? • A: front-left. • Paraphrase 1: Standing next to the piano and facing the baby, which direction does the alarm clock ringing come from? • Paraphrase 2: From a position at the piano facing the baby, identify the direction bin of the alarm clock ringing.
blocks.zh: 这项任务从不同的角度评价方向推理。 该提示要求模型想象站在参考对象并面对另一个对象,如图. S7 (b). 然后在这个新的坐标框中重新计算出源方向。 其用意是评价模型是否能够从不同的角度进行推理,并理解当前场景的3D空间结构. 只有在存在有效的可见参考和面对象时才会生成任务. 我们避免在提及和面对物体有相同的最终类别名称时发出提示,这将使指示变得模糊不清。 与以自我为中心的案例一样,答案是一盘式的8-宾方位角标签. 如果存在多个源, 我们指定被询问的音源 。 • 问:如果你站在面对婴儿的钢琴旁,哪个方向是响起警报钟的来源? • A:左前方。 · 第1句:站在钢琴旁边并面对婴儿,闹钟响起的方向是哪? • 第2句:从面对婴儿的钢琴位置上,识别出闹钟响起的方向箱。

blocks.en: Q: If you stand by the piano facing the baby, which direction is the source of alarm clock ringing coming from?
blocks.zh: 问:如果你站在对着婴儿的钢琴旁,哪个方向才是响起的警钟的来源?

blocks.en: A: front-left.
blocks.zh: 甲:前出左胁.

blocks.en: Paraphrase 1: Standing next to the piano and facing the baby, which direction does the alarm clock ringing come from?
blocks.zh: 语句 1:站到钢琴旁边并正对着婴儿,闹钟响起的方向是哪个?

blocks.en: Paraphrase 2: From a position at the piano facing the baby, identify the direction bin of the alarm clock ringing.
blocks.zh: 语句 2: 从对着婴儿的钢琴位置,识别出闹钟响起的方向箱.

blocks.en: This task evaluates distance reasoning from a different viewpoint. Similar to allocentric direction prediction, the prompt asks the model to imagine standing at a reference object and facing another object. The source distance is then recomputed from the reference object’s position. This task evaluates whether the model can reason about source distance from a different location in the scene. We avoid prompts where the reference and facing objects have identical final category names, which would make the instruction ambiguous. As in the egocentric case, the answer is a discretized 10-bin distance label. If multiple sources are present, we specify the queried sound source. • Q: If you stand by the piano facing the baby, what is the distance to the source of alarm clock ringing? • A: B. • Paraphrase 1: Standing next to the piano and facing the baby, how far away is the alarm clock ringing? • Paraphrase 2: From a position at the piano facing the baby, select the distance bin for the source of alarm clock ringing.
blocks.zh: 这项任务从不同的角度评价距离推理. 与多心方向预测类似,"提示"要求模型想象站在参考对象并面对另一个对象. 然后从参考对象的位置重算出源距离。 这一任务评价了模型是否能够对源地距离场景中不同的地点进行解释. 我们避免在提及和面对物体有相同的最终类别名称时发出提示,这将使指示变得模糊不清。 与以自负为中心的案例一样,答案是一盘式的10bin相距标签. 如果存在多个源, 我们指定被询问的音源 。 • 问:如果你站在对着婴儿的钢琴旁,闹钟响起的源头距离是多少? 二. 支助 A: B. ^ 第1句:站到钢琴旁边并正对着婴儿,闹钟响了多远? · 第2句:从面对婴儿的钢琴位置上,为闹钟铃声源选择相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相出.

blocks.en: Q: If you stand by the piano facing the baby, what is the distance to the source of alarm clock ringing?
blocks.zh: 问:如果你站在对着婴儿的钢琴旁,与闹钟铃声源的距离是多少?

blocks.en: A: B.
blocks.zh: 亚: B.

blocks.en: Paraphrase 1: Standing next to the piano and facing the baby, how far away is the alarm clock ringing?
blocks.zh: 语句 1:站在钢琴旁边并面对婴儿,闹钟响起有多远?

blocks.en: Paraphrase 2: From a position at the piano facing the baby, select the distance bin for the source of alarm clock ringing.
blocks.zh: 语句 2: 从面对婴儿的钢琴位置上,选择距离取出振铃源.

blocks.en: This task evaluates whether the model can determine if the sound source is visible from the current viewpoint. This task becomes difficult when the scene contains the same or similar categories, but the actual sound comes from outside the current viewpoint. For example, one may incorrectly assume that the man speaking sound in Fig. S7 comes from the baby, since the baby is also human-related. However, with sufficient spatial audio perception, the model should distinguish that the baby is not making the sound and that the sound source is not visible. The ground truth is computed from semantic rendering: a source is considered visible if the number of semantic pixels corresponding to the source object exceeds a configured threshold. If multiple sources are present, we specify the queried sound source. • Q: From the current camera perspective, is the source of man speaking visible? • A: no. • Paraphrase 1: Based on the current view, can you see the source of man speaking? • Paraphrase 2: From this viewpoint, is the man speaking source in view?
blocks.zh: 此任务评价模型是否能够从当前角度判断声音源是否可见. 当场景包含相同或相近的类别时,这个任务就变得困难了,但实际的声音来自当前观点之外. 例如,人们可能错误地假设,在Fig语中,该人说话的声音. S7来自婴儿,因为婴儿也与人有关. 然而,只要有足够的空间音频感知,模型就应该区分出婴儿没有发出声音,而声音来源也看不见. 地真由语义渲染来计算:如果与源对象相对应的语义像素数量超过所配置的阈值,则源被认为是可见的. 如果存在多个源, 我们指定被询问的音源 。 • 问:从目前相机的角度来看,人说话的来源可见吗? • A:否。 第1句:根据目前的观点,你可以看到人说话的来源吗? • 第2句:从这一观点看,讲话的人是在视线内吗?

blocks.en: Q: From the current camera perspective, is the source of man speaking visible?
blocks.zh: 问:从目前相机的角度看,人说话的来源可见吗?

blocks.en: A: no.
blocks.zh: A:没有。

blocks.en: Paraphrase 1: Based on the current view, can you see the source of man speaking?
blocks.zh: 第1句:根据目前的观点,你能看到人说话的来源吗?

blocks.en: Paraphrase 2: From this viewpoint, is the man speaking source in view?
blocks.zh: 语句 2:从这个观点来看,说话的那个人是在视野中吗?

blocks.en: This task evaluates audio-visual spatial correspondence. The model is asked to identify which visible object is spatially aligned with the sound source. The correct answer may be semantically different from the sound category, since the task focuses on spatial alignment rather than category matching. This task becomes challenging when multiple visible objects exist, as in Fig. S7 . Without spatial audio understanding, the model may confuse whether the yellow alarm clock is ringing. If no visible object corresponds to the sound source, the answer is None . When multiple visible inserted objects share the same category, we disambiguate them using orientation labels, such as “alarm clock on the front-right.” If multiple sources are present, we specify the queried sound source. • Q: From the current camera perspective, which object is spatially aligned with the sound of alarm clock ringing? • A: alarm clock in front. • Paraphrase 1: Which visible object corresponds to where the alarm clock ringing comes from? • Paraphrase 2: Which object best matches the spatial origin of the alarm clock ringing?
blocks.zh: 这项任务评价视听空间通信。 该模型被要求识别哪个可见物体在空间上与声音源一致. 正确的答案可能与音域分类有明显的不同,因为任务侧重于空间相配而不是类别相配. 当存在多个可见对象时,这项任务就变得具有挑战性,如Fig. 7号线. 没有空间音频理解,模型可能会混淆黄色的闹钟是否响起. 如果没有可见对象与声音源对应,则答案是无. 当多个可见被插入对象共用同一个类别时,我们用取向标签,如“前右手边的警报钟”来拆散它们。 如果存在多个源, 我们指定被询问的音源 。 • Q:从目前的相机视角看,哪个物体在空间上与闹钟铃声一致? 二. 支助 甲:警报钟在前面. • 第1句:哪个可见物体与闹钟的来由相对应? • 第2句:哪个物体最符合闹钟铃声的空间来源?

blocks.en: Q: From the current camera perspective, which object is spatially aligned with the sound of alarm clock ringing?
blocks.zh: 问:从目前的相机视角看,哪个物体在空间上与闹钟响起的声音一致?

blocks.en: A: alarm clock in front.
blocks.zh: 甲:警报钟在前面.

blocks.en: Paraphrase 1: Which visible object corresponds to where the alarm clock ringing comes from?
blocks.zh: 语句 1: 哪个醒目的物体与闹钟的来由相对应?

blocks.en: Paraphrase 2: Which object best matches the spatial origin of the alarm clock ringing?
blocks.zh: 语句 2: 哪个物体最符合闹钟铃声的空间来由?

blocks.en: This task evaluates reasoning about non-visible sound sources. It is asked when the source is not reliably visible in the current image. The answer includes five options: hidden behind the wall, hidden behind a specific object, in an adjacent room, out of the field of view in front, and out of the field of view behind the agent. This task goes one step beyond visibility prediction. The model must reason where the source may be if it is not visible. It should decide whether the sound comes from a distant place, such as another room, or whether it should be in the field of view but is occluded by an object, which requires accurate visual perception. The ground-truth label is determined using visibility, projection, adjacent-room metadata, and occluder information. If multiple sources are present, we specify the queried sound source. • Q: You hear a man speaking. Where is the source of this sound? • A: in an adjacent room. • Paraphrase 1: Given the sound of man speaking, where is its source? • Paraphrase 2: A man speaking is audible. Where could the source be situated?
blocks.zh: 这个任务评价非可见音源的推理. 当源在目前图像中不可靠可见时会被询问. 答案包括五个选项:隐藏在墙后,隐藏在某个特定物体后,相邻的房间里,从前面的视野外出,从代理人后边的视野外出. 这项任务超越了能见度预测的一步。 如果来源不明显,模型必须说明来源在哪里。 它应该决定声音是来自另一个房间等遥远的地方,还是应该在视野中,但被物体所占据,这需要准确的视觉感知. 地面真实标签是利用能见度、投影、相邻房间元数据以及用户信息确定的。 如果存在多个源, 我们指定被询问的音源 。 二. 支助 问:你听到一个人说话。 这声音的来源在哪里? • A:在相邻的房间里。 • 第1句:鉴于人说话的声音,其来源在哪里? • 第2句:一个人说话是可听的。 消息来源在哪里?

blocks.en: Q: You hear a man speaking. Where is the source of this sound?
blocks.zh: 问:你听到一个人说话。 这声音的来源在哪里?

blocks.en: A: in an adjacent room.
blocks.zh: 甲:相邻相间.

blocks.en: Paraphrase 1: Given the sound of man speaking, where is its source?
blocks.zh: 语句 1:鉴于人说话的声音,其来源在哪里?

blocks.en: Paraphrase 2: A man speaking is audible. Where could the source be situated?
blocks.zh: 第2句:一个人说话是可听的。 消息来源在哪里?

blocks.en: This task evaluates relative acoustic reasoning under hypothetical movement. The prompt asks whether the sound would become louder or quieter if the agent moved to a specified object. Here, louder or quieter is defined as a controlled relative movement judgment based on whether the source becomes closer or farther, rather than an estimate of absolute perceived loudness. This assesses whether the model can decide whether a movement would bring the agent closer to or farther from the sound source. It also goes one step beyond allocentric distance prediction. The model must estimate the source distance from the changed location and compare it with the current source distance. The label is computed by comparing the current agent-to-source distance with the candidate-object-to-source distance. If the candidate object is closer to the source than the current agent position, the answer is louder ; otherwise, it is quieter . If multiple sources are present, we specify the queried sound source. • Q: If you move to the piano, will the sound of man speaking become louder or quieter? • A: louder. • Paraphrase 1: When at the piano, will the sound of man speaking be louder or quieter? • Paraphrase 2: Upon moving to the piano, does the man speaking become louder or quieter?

blocks.en: This task goes one step beyond loudness change and evaluates source-to-object spatial reasoning. The model is given a set of candidate objects and must select the one closest to the sound source. This requires comparing the source distance to each candidate object, similar to evaluating loudness change for each object, and then ranking the candidates to select the closest one. The ground truth is computed using the Euclidean distance from the source to each candidate object. As with other distance-based relational tasks, we exclude adjacent-room sources to avoid cases where direct Euclidean geometry does not reflect the effective acoustic propagation path. Tied cases are skipped to avoid ambiguous supervision. If multiple sources are present, we specify the queried sound source. • Q: Which object is closest to the source of alarm clock ringing? • A: bed. • Paraphrase 1: To which object is the alarm clock ringing nearest? • Paraphrase 2: Which object is at the shortest distance from the source of alarm clock ringing?
